p: Borehamwood and Elstree have played a huge part in British film and TV history. Elstree Studios on Shenley Road has hosted all sorts of famous productions over the decades, and the BBC Elstree Centre nearby is where EastEnders is made. Many classic films were shot in the area's studios, and you can still feel that connection as you drive through the town.

For families, one of the best outdoor spots nearby is Aldenham Country Park, with its reservoir, woodland walks, farm animals and the Winnie the Pooh-themed 100 Aker Wood, where you can play Poohsticks and look for the characters' homes. It's a brilliant follow-on to a session on the trampolines, especially for younger children.

Harry Potter fans should know that Warner Bros. Studio Tour London is in Leavesden, a short drive away, where you can see the sets, costumes and props from the films. Tickets must be booked well in advance, so plan ahead if you want to combine the two. Elstree and Borehamwood station is on the Thameslink line, making it easy to reach from central London. A tip for AirHop: if you're planning a party, book early, as weekend slots can fill up fast. And bring a spare pair of socks for the drive home, because everyone's feet will be warm. With the studio, the park and the trampolines close together, this corner of Hertfordshire makes for a properly fun family day out. Shenley Road itself has plenty of cafes, takeaways and shops, so a quick refuel is never far away. If you have time, the village of Shenley nearby has open countryside and quiet lanes, perfect for a gentle walk to round off a busy, bouncy day.
